content: {"phoneNote":"The phone first screen works well: a sharp, relevant derailleur photo above a headline that fits, intro and one gold button; the lower page is a long single column with a 5-item price grid that leaves an orphan.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero is a solid split layout, but the price grid leaves one orphan item on a second row and the Soča section has a tall portrait photo beside a thin text block, creating large empty bands.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Rebalance the price grid: five items in a 4-column (desktop) / 2-column (phone) grid leaves a stray '8 €' item; use a 5-column row or a vertical price list with rules.","Shrink the Soča photo to a landscape crop matching the text block height, and tighten the dead bands above and below the 'Kaj delamo' two-column text on desktop.","Give the hero a trade-specific touch (e.g. workshop detail strip, opening-season badge near the headline) so it reads less as the standard split-hero pattern."],"blockers":[]}
